contrast.description: Standard or more contrast, or the device's setting; absent: system.

date_format.description: How dates are written on screen: 12 Oct 2026 (d_mmm_yyyy), 12/10/2026 (dd_mm_yyyy), 10/12/2026 (mm_dd_yyyy) or 2026-10-12 (iso), in the organisation's time zone (NFR-L10N-01); absent: d_mmm_yyyy.

default_mode.description: The mode in force while the caller has not chosen: from the organisation's starting mode for each of their roles, the Owner's winning when they hold it (FR-UX-27).

density.description: The row height of lists and tables; absent: comfortable.

ledger_view.description: Plain view or Accountant view where a screen offers both, in Expert mode (FR-UX-08); absent: plain.

mode.description: The experience mode the caller chose; absent until they choose, when default_mode applies.

motion.description: Whether transitions run; the organisation's switch and the device's reduced-motion setting always win; absent: on.

negative_format.description: How negative amounts are written on screen: −1,234.56 (minus) or (1,234.56) (parentheses); the sign or the brackets always show, so colour is never the only cue; absent: minus.

number_format.description: How amounts and counts are written on screen: 1,234.56 (comma_dot), 1.234,56 (dot_comma), 1 234,56 (space_comma) or 1 234.56 (space_dot). Amounts stay exact decimal strings everywhere else (NFR-L10N-01); absent: comma_dot.

set_at.description: When the caller last saved their preferences, if ever.

shortcut_keys.description: The keys the caller chose for a shortcut, by its name on the shortcut sheet; a shortcut not listed keeps its usual keys (FR-UX-06).

shortcuts_on.description: Whether the single-key shortcuts are on (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.4); absent: on.

theme.description: Light, dark or the device's setting (FR-UX-38); absent: system.
